video_multi_row_benchmark.notes: Used as the benchmark ground truth for evaluating rear-corner occlusion and sustained hand-raise FSM accuracy.

person_detection_reliability.foreground_students: 100% detection rate across all sampled frames.
person_detection_reliability.distant_students: Detected when head and shoulder silhouettes exceed 20px letterboxed.
person_detection_reliability.teacher_separation: Teacher at front wall near blackboard detected with full-body bounding box; spatial centroid separates teacher from seated cluster.

rear_view_pose_performance.shoulder_detection: Left and right shoulders (kpts 5, 6) robustly resolved even with students facing away from the camera.
rear_view_pose_performance.elevation_delta: When hand is raised above shoulder plane, wrist y-coordinate drops below shoulder y-coordinate, reliably triggering hand-raise classification.

occlusion_and_uncertainty_handling.desk_occlusion: Lower extremities (hips, knees, ankles) occluded by desks are marked invisible/unobserved; does not perturb upper-body pose estimation.
occlusion_and_uncertainty_handling.lateral_student_occlusion: Partial overlap in distant rows handled by IoU matching; when wrist confidence falls below threshold, state transitions safely to NEEDS_REVIEW.
occlusion_and_uncertainty_handling.non_raising_gestures: Head touching, scratching, and resting elbows on desks maintain wrists at or below head level, preventing spurious hand-raise triggers.
